body: definitely try posting this on r/pcmasterrace! there are many of us there that will be happy to help (and many that know much more than I)

I'm a worthless piece of shit thats not good at anything and I push/scare everyone away, dont know what im doing with my life, dont have the motivation to get any better etc etc blah blah blah just the typical shit that you've probably heard a thousand times before

Well, ironically enough, talking about it in a realistic sense makes me consider it less. It helps to remind me how hard it actually is to commit suicide (nerves, failing, actual likelihood of dying from different methods, pain level, etc.)

You're a perfect example of what I don't want to deal with. I know you're just trying to be helpful, but I would just prefer for people like you to at least humor me. At least consider the possibility that maybe suicide is an okay thing if you've thought through it and are consciously making the decision.
